# GAMbit Release Notes

- **Sign-in certificate monitoring:** Added **Single sign-on → Certificates**. Save your provider’s metadata link or select a certificate file to enable daily monitoring. Receive warnings 30, 14, and 3 days before expiration, plus alerts when your provider switches to a certificate Google does not yet have. **Upload to Google** adds the replacement alongside the existing certificate.

- **Daily email security checks:** Added **Domain & extras → Email security** to check SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and MX records across all domains and aliases, with specific guidance for changes at your DNS host. Checks run daily and fall back to Windows’ built-in lookup tool if web-based lookups are blocked.

- **Activity log integrity checks:** Log entries are now fingerprinted, digitally signed, and linked to the previous entry. Use **Activity log → Check the log for edits** to detect entries changed, added, reordered, or removed outside GAMbit. **Undo** and **Run again** reject edited entries. Google Sheet copies now include an **Integrity** column and **Log fingerprints** tab, with nightly copies preserved through Sheet version history. Entries created before this update cannot be verified.

- **English and Spanish printouts:** Account cards, class card sets, and Welcome sheets now support English, Spanish, or both, plus an optional note for families. Set the default language and customize wording under **Settings → Appearance and safety → Printouts**.

- **Archive before account deletion:** “Delete suspended accounts” clean-up rules can now specify an archive account for Drive files and, optionally, Calendar data. After approval, each account is deleted only when Google confirms its transfer is complete and the account remains suspended. Failed or stalled transfers trigger an alert. **Gmail is not transferred; use a Vault retention rule if mail must be retained.**

- **Signed deletion records:** Every account deletion, regardless of how it is initiated, is recorded under **Clean-up rules → Deletion record**, with CSV export available.
